project.name: Archic Website
project.sector: digital systems, web and custom software studio

direction.justification: Archic must explain a connected digital system and prove it with operational interfaces in the first viewport. Type establishes the commercial promise; data and white-label product UI provide evidence. Editorial Spread creates a recognisable public voice while Dossier rows keep services, method, investment and QA exact and comparable.
direction.archetypeRepeatJustification: This is Archic's own reference implementation. The archetype is selected from its content and proof requirements, not inherited from client work.

exceptions.reason: The repository does not contain enough source and licence evidence for the legacy JPG and WebP sets. They now live under src/assets/concept, no production route imports them, and all public product proof uses Archic-authored white-label SVG interfaces with explicit demo labels.
